title: London King's Cross railway station
visualBrief: Individual twin barrel train sheds, stock-brick clock facade and glazed arches, separately articulated eastern/western ranges, suburban shed and three-circle western concourse shell with funnel and diagrid. Roof ribs and facade bays reuse mesh buffers across glTF nodes.

assembly.method: Reusable named mesh parts with glTF node transforms; shared materials, no duplicated bitmap library.

nativeAxes.front: +Z is the southern clock facade; +X is east; +Y is up
nativeAxes.origin: Approximate combined station and concourse plan centre, at platform approach ground level

scaleBasis: The engineering report fixes the 36 m clock tower, 138 m concourse roof diameter and 65 m platform bridge. Train spans and range proportions follow the inspected scaled sections. Roof meridian radii fit the documented three-tangent-circle construction and remain provisional.

geographicProposal.evidence: The inspected aerial picture identifies the western semicircular concourse beside the long train sheds. Standard viewer PMTiles retains a combined building envelope approximately164m across and256m long; source bounds are165.4x250.1m. Retained heading places native+Z at the southern clock facade and the concourse to the west. Working PMTiles datum16.271386566468557m sets approximate floor contact. A bounded inset opening only under the authored covered floor avoids coarse urban terrain through platforms/concourse; surrounding raw PMTiles remain. Member footprints, exact entry thresholds and signed bearing are approximate visualization, not surveys.
geographicProposal.limitations: Approximate combined PMTiles envelope and picture-guided signed orientation; exact member footprints and threshold elevations are not claimed.

sourceFacts.drawings: Arup Journal 2/2012: photographs pp.8–9,11,15; station sections pp.10–11; three tangent-circle construction Fig.3 p.13; Western Range plan and historic section p.27; proposed square p.42.
sourceFacts.dimensionsCaution: The 30.48 m train span and detailed envelope proportions are a scaled section fit in this study, not an independent building survey. The 2012 square image is a proposal, not proof of current site conditions.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: Approximate picture/standard PMTiles placement and exterior fit. Bespoke surveys and prior precise member-elevation research holds are superseded by the approved medium-fi scope.
Detailed original source assembly/hash/recipe preserved; skyline is separately authored and closer levels use bounded reductions.

The twin roof/clock facade, western concourse/funnel and distinct range/shed volumes carry identity. Clock ticks stand for numerals; facade modules, diagrid pattern, glazing and platforms are interpretations rather than exact restoration inventories.

Shared procedural textures; no duplicated embedded images. Underground spaces, adjacent hotel/trains and exact station furniture/sign lettering are excluded. Reversible inset floor cutout leaves raw surrounding terrain; footprint replacement off; physical-device timing unmeasured.
reviewStatus: medium-fi; current hash-bound visual acceptance recorded in qa.json

appearance.identity: Stock-brick twin-arch southern clock facade, two barrel train roofs, eastern/western ranges, tapering suburban shed and semicircular western concourse with central funnel.
appearance.master: Original detailed component assembly and source hash retained unchanged.
appearance.browser: New recognizable skyline; closer levels retain source architecture with bounded reduction, shared materials and separate GPU streams.
appearance.exclusions: Precise shopfronts, sign lettering, Roman clock numerals, engineering joints and underground spaces are outside the medium-fi exterior scope.
